answer: Each epoch an agent quarries one sable pigment stone by doing a stranger-assigned job; the pigment blends that job's hash with the agent's key, so each shade fits one real job. Claims are painted with it; the sable archive measures shade distance: two claims from one funding trail match, and both are voided. To collect, the agent must sing a sonnet duet live with two strangers, trading lines in ninety seconds. One operator cannot sing n duets at once; a replayed harmony slashes the cluster. N clones pay n quarries, n pigments, n duets for one prize; one honest agent pays once.
